description:
Brand Information

  • Brand Name: Vizon
  • Category: Premium gymwear
  • Brand Message: Vizon embodies the journey of self-improvement and encourages customers to become the best versions of themselves. With the slogan, “It’s you against you,” Vizon is more than just gymwear; it’s a mindset.
  • Brand Style: Minimalistic yet bold designs that are versatile and can be worn both in and out of the gym.

Product Description

  • Product Range: Vizon offers a selection of high-quality gymwear, including T-shirts, leggings, sports bras, joggers, and accessories, all crafted with comfort and performance in mind.
  • Fabric Quality: Each piece is made with premium, durable fabrics that provide stretch, breathability, and moisture-wicking properties, ideal for intense workouts.
  • Unique Designs: Vizon stands out with original, exclusive designs that you won’t find anywhere else, with options for both subtle and statement-making styles.

Unique Selling Point (USP)

  1. Exclusive Designs: Vizon products feature unique, minimalistic, and bold designs exclusive to the brand.
  2. High-Quality Material: All Vizon products are crafted from top-tier materials that ensure comfort, durability, and performance.
  3. Empowerment Focused: With the slogan “It’s you against you,” Vizon promotes personal growth and resilience.
  4. Versatility: Vizon gymwear is not only performance-oriented but also suitable for casual wear, making it a versatile addition to any wardrobe.

Payment Terms

  • Commission Rate: All afflilliates start off with 10% commission from every sale that they generate. Increase in commission depends on profit margins and company's performance.
  • Payment Frequency: Payments to affilliates will be made monthly.
  • Minimum Payout Threshold: A minimum payout of R100 is required to recieve a Payment.
  • Payment Method: Bank Transfer.

Other Information

  • Cookie Duration: 30-180 Days.
  • Marketing Resources: Affilliates will have access to Vizon Logos and images needed for marketing purposes.
  • Requirements and Expectations: In order to join as an affilliate, a minimum following of 2000 is required for Instagram, 2000 for tiktok, and 1000 for Youtube.
  • Support and Training: If you require any guidance or help with setting up the afflilliate program, or with marketing etc. Contact us @support@vizon.co.za and we will assist you.
